doc: stages/filters.straighten.rst is new at 2.6.0; its Options section lists `polyline` -- 'definition of a 3D linestring with measurment (LINESTRING ZM in wkt) along which the cloud will be straighten ... This is mandatory' -- `offset`, 'a starting meter point. [Default: 0]', and `reverse`, 'whether to straighten or unstraighten the point cloud [Default: `false`]'. The stage is registered at 2.6.0, so `pdal --options filters.straighten` (apps/index.rst) reports its table on stdout; at 2.5.0 the stage does not exist and stdout is empty. Option NAMES only: no shipped page shows how `--options` renders a default, so the rendering is not graded -- only that these three options are there.
